enabled.description: Drop over time: Off: hunger and thirst only change through items, scripts and admins.

hunger.description: Hunger drop: Points lost every minute of play, out of 100. 0.25 empties in about 6.5 hours.

thirst.description: Thirst drop: Points lost every minute of play, out of 100. 0.25 empties in about 6.5 hours.

hunger.description: Starting hunger: What a new character starts with, out of 100 (100 = full).

thirst.description: Starting thirst: What a new character starts with, out of 100 (100 = full).

notify.description: Low warning: A notification when food or water falls below the warning level (hungry, thirsty or both).

lowAt.description: Warning level: Food or water below this (out of 100) shows the warning.

notifyEvery.description: Warning every: Seconds between two warnings while food or water stays low.

faint.description: Dizziness: Below the critical level the screen fades out and back in.

criticalAt.description: Critical level: Food or water below this (out of 100) starts dizziness and health loss (whichever is on) and shows the critical warning. Keep it under the warning level.

faintEvery.description: Dizziness every: Seconds between two dizzy spells while food or water stays critical.

fadeOut.description: Fade out: Seconds the screen takes to go dark or come back.

fadeIn.description: Fade in: Seconds the screen takes to go dark or come back.

hurt.description: Health loss: Below the critical level the player loses health over time.

damage.description: Health lost: Health taken each time.

hurtEvery.description: Health loss every: Seconds between two health losses while food or water stays critical.
